## Headline numbers used across all D2P policy documents

All three policy documents draw their quantitative claims from this single shared parameter set. To revise an assumption, **edit `posts/_shared_parameters.qmd`** — every document that includes it will update on the next render.

**Burden (per year, South Africa):**

| Parameter | Value | Source / status |
|:----------|------:|:----------------|
| NMC pesticide-poisoning notifications | ~690 | NMC 2020–2024 annual reports |
| NHLS severe BChE inhibitions (live patients) | ~2,000 | NHLS LIS, 2020–2024 |
| Poisons Information Helpline pesticide calls | ~9,000 | PIH Annual Report 2019 |
| Total suspected pesticide-poisoning cases / year | **~11,690** | Sum of three mutually-exclusive streams (placeholder for record-linkage) |
| Case-fatality rate (CFR, mid-range) | 13 % | NMC observed range 10–15 %; under-counts intentional self-poisoning under ICD-10 default rules |
| Annual deaths | **~1,500 – 1,800** | 11,690 × CFR |
| Per-case morbidity cost | R12,000 | Existing decision-model parameter |
| Per-death mortality cost | R1,500,000 | Human-capital approach, existing model |
| **Per-case societal cost** | **~R197,000** | R12,000 + 0.13 × R1.5M |
| **Total annual economic burden** | **~R2.3 billion / year** | 11,690 × R197,000 |

**Decision-tree parameters (placeholders — to be re-estimated from pilot):**

| Parameter | Symbol | Value | Used in |
|:----------|:------:|------:|:--------|
| Loop-closure prevention efficacy | η | 0.30 | Burden-avoided model; outcome subtree |
| Secondary cases per unaddressed source | ρ | 3.0 | Outcome subtree |
| P(index death) | p_death | 0.13 | Outcome subtree |
| P(severe morbidity, ICU/admission) | p_severe | 0.27 | Outcome subtree |
| P(full recovery) | p_recover | 0.60 | Outcome subtree |

**Status-quo coordination transition probabilities (per suspected case):**

| Node | Decision | P(Yes) |
|:-----|:---------|------:|
| Q1 | Clinician/PHO files on NMC | 0.30 |
| Q2 | NMC SMS reaches local EHP | 0.95 |
| Q3 | EHP investigates | 0.60 |
| Q4 | Investigation recorded on NMC | 0.05 |
| Q5 | EHP refers to DALRRD | 0.30 |
| Q6 | DALRRD acts | 0.50 |
| Q7 | DALRRD feeds back to NMC + clinician | 0.10 |

Joint P(loop fully closes) ≈ **1.1 %** under the status quo.

Full numerical derivations live in the [Decision Model](decision_model.qmd) and the [Costing Analysis](costing_analysis.qmd).
:::
